claude missing, logged out, or authMethod not claude.ai: Blocks spawning, shows the exact fix command
ANTHROPIC_API_KEY set in the shell: Strips it (and M4's list) from every child including exo run, shows a one-time notice
Limit hit mid-job: Pauses the queue, records the reset time, resumes on its own after the reset
App or daemon crash, Mac sleeps or reboots: Reconciles by pid plus start time, resumes or marks each job, loses no card, leaves no orphan
exo run parked / stopped / crashed / refused: Shows report.md and the reason; parked becomes a gate card, the others a bug card with resume, retry or discard
Merge or rebase conflict: Parks the job with the conflicting files, offers a find-cause or manual route
Dirty tree or another run holds the lock: Shows exo's refusal text, queues the job behind the lock
Offline: Queues jobs, keeps the UI fully usable, resumes when back online
Job loops (same failing line twice, no new commits): exo run: exo's no-progress or attempt-cap stop becomes a bug card with its Reason:; -p: stops at the second identical failing line, bug card
Project folder moved or deleted: Marks the project missing, asks the user to relocate it
Unknown or malformed stream event: Logs it raw, keeps the job alive
exo not loaded or too old: Shows how to install or update it
Huge tool output: Stores it on disk, shows a trimmed view with "load full"
init invariant mismatch (M4): Kills the process group before the first tool result is accepted, Needs-you card naming the field
Overage active (M7): Admits no new job, drains running ones, gauge shows overage, waits for the explicit toggle
Mixed gates: limit gate plus another open gate (M8): No auto-approve; gate card listing every open gate
Main checkout fast-forward refused (M3): Shows exo's refusal and the main checkout's local edits as a card; touches nothing there
Worktree missing deps (S7): Runs the setup step before the job; a setup failure is a setup card, not a code bug card
Branch-name collision (S15): Caught at Approve, shown on the card, not queued
Stalled session (S13): Marks stalled after N quiet minutes, then the wall timeout kills the group, outcome timeout
Clone delete with local-only work (M11): Lists uncommitted, ignored, stashed, unpushed, worktrees and live runs; approval; folder to Trash
With the API key set in the shell, no child process sees it, and claude auth status gates every launch (test plus one live check).
Every Situations row passes its fixture test; tests.json shows them all passing.
Killing the daemon mid-job and restarting it resumes or correctly marks every job, with no lost card or orphaned process.
From card to approved brief to a landed exo run takes no more than 3 clicks plus approvals.
The queue never starts a job past the budget ceiling (fixture test with a simulated limit state).
The design review checklist passes on all screens at both widths, and the screenshots are saved.
docs/progress.md lets a fresh session continue without asking the user anything.
